title: Overview of the Plagiarism Detection Task at PAN 2026
abstract: arXiv:2611.20443v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The generative plagiarism detection task at PAN 2026 aims at retrieving the original scientific sources for given automatically generated textual plagiarism. We created two novel datasets of synthetically generated plagiarism following the premise of a malicious actor trying to generate papers with minimal effort while evading detection of undisclosed re-use. We utilized four widely available LLMs: GPT-OSS 120B, Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 3.5 27B FP8, and DeepSeek-R1 Distill Llama 8B. In this task overview paper, we outline the creation of this dataset and summarize and compare the results of all participants with three baselines. For this year's task, we received 26 submissions from six teams that significantly outperformed our baselines.

translated_abstract: PAN 2026的生成式剽窃检测任务旨在为给定的自动生成文本剽窃检索其原始科学来源。我们遵循恶意行为者试图以最小努力生成论文并逃避对未披露重复使用检测的前提，创建了两个合成生成剽窃的新型数据集。我们使用了四种广泛可用的大语言模型：GPT-OSS 120B、Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen 3.5 27B FP8和DeepSeek-R1 Distill Llama 8B。在这篇任务概述论文中，我们概述了该数据集的创建过程，并总结和比较了所有参与者与三个基线方法的结果。在今年的任务中，我们收到了来自六个团队的26份提交，这些提交显著超越了我们的基线。
tldr: PAN 2026生成式剽窃检测任务利用四种大语言模型创建了两个模拟恶意低成本生成并逃避检测的合成剽窃数据集，六个团队的26份参赛提交显著超越了三个基线方法。
en_tdlr: The PAN 2026 generative plagiarism detection task created two novel synthetic plagiarism datasets using four widely available LLMs to simulate low-effort malicious paper generation that evades detection, and the 26 submissions from six teams significantly outperformed three baselines.
